title: Experiment - Astra AI - Build a game that would be challenging for a human
author: IllustriousWater2796
selftext:
Alright, so I'm no game developer by any means. I've touched on it before years ago, and I thought, well, now AI is quite powerful, how easy would it be to make a simple game?

I thought Godot / Blender would be easy enough, as if it's mainly scriptable, AI wouldn't have much issue.

Anyway, fast forward, after a few hours and a few prompts, it generated the game above. It obviously isn't anything flash, and I can see other people have done so much better, but I wanted to see if an AI could truly make a challenging game.

And lo and behold, I've now been playing this for 2 hours, and it truly did a good job at challenging me.

Truly impressed with AI and how far it has gotten.

I believe in the future we won't have to worry about the technicalities, but focus on delving deep into our creative minds and worry more about the creative aspect of things. However, we may also see a flood of garbage coming through as well.

Let’s also be honest, does anyone code anymore? I work at a big tech company, I won’t name it here, but let me tell you, most of the devs I know barely touch code at all.

Is that a bad thing? In my opinion, no. I’m not saying technical knowledge isn’t needed, it absolutely is. But if you understand the tech stack well enough and have the proper precautions in place, for example, local dev, staging, and production, does it really matter whether you personally wrote every line of code? If a junior dev made a mistake, you would still need systems in place to catch those mistakes anyway.

And I think this game is also proof of the other side of that argument. The game AI made looks absolutely garbage, and that’s because I have basically no game dev experience in Godot at all. AI could write the code for me, but I didn’t have enough knowledge of the technology to properly guide it.

So it proves that you still need to have a good fundamental understanding of the technology you’re trying to use. Because if you don’t, even with the most advanced AI, you can still end up making garbage.

Very interesting indeed!

P.S. I only beat it once. You can also demo this monstrosity of a game, if you do beat it please let me know.
